reasoningChain.evidence: Maximizing the verified ranger's output before Chapter 2 combat supports progression.
The ranger's sustained single-target mark behavior solved the previous damage wall.
The legendary gloves more than double the physical power of the ranger's current gloves and add mark strength, might, shield break, execution damage, counter damage, and life steal.
The active ranger can use the mark-specific damage affix immediately; the higher listed militia and assassin fits are inactive and lack current combat evidence.
